title: Nexus
description: A Minecraft Core plugin for small servers!
body:
**Nexus** – The Ultimate Server Utility Plugin
Tired of juggling dozens of plugins for basic commands? **Nexus** packs all the essentials into one lightweight, powerful package. Manage gamemodes, teleportation, inventory access, and much more — all in a single plugin.

✅ **All-in-One Solution** – Anvil, crafting table, ender chest, grindstone, spawn, setspawn, broadcast, and more.
✅ **Player Management** – Heal, fly, freeze, clear inventory, invsee, teleport.
✅ **Gamemode Switching** – Adventure, Survival, Creative, Spectator in seconds.
✅ **PlaceholderAPI Support** – Fully customizable messages and placeholders.

Lightweight, fast, and easy to configure — Nexus is the only utility plugin you’ll ever need

**Servers Running Nexus**

    **mc.ezmp.fun** – A live SMP server currently using Nexus
    To check if a server runs Nexus, try the command /nexus author. (Note: some servers may block this.)
